description: This file defines the 'Cluster' interface and its implementation for managing cluster members in etcd, including methods for listing, adding, removing, updating, and promoting members.

classes.name: cluster
classes.description: Implementation of the Cluster interface, managing cluster member operations via gRPC client.

methods.name: MemberAdd
methods.description: Adds a new member to the cluster.

methods.name: MemberAddAsLearner
methods.description: Adds a new learner member to the cluster.

methods.name: MemberRemove
methods.description: Removes a member from the cluster.

methods.name: MemberUpdate
methods.description: Updates the peer addresses of a cluster member.

methods.name: MemberPromote
methods.description: Promotes a member from learner to voting member.
